title: Build local Ableton Live MCP server
acceptanceCriteria: Provides an MCP stdio server exposing Ableton-oriented tools
Includes a local bridge strategy for Ableton Live control
Includes setup and smoke-test documentation
Provides MCP tools for VST/plugin inventory and selection for MIDI tracks
Provides MCP tools for MIDI import and clip creation
Provides MCP tools for export/render and mastering chains
Provides MCP tools for modifying project tracks, mixer state, devices, and automation through the local bridge
assumptions: Ableton control will run through a local bridge such as Max for Live
or a future Live API adapter rather than direct DAW memory access.
goal: Create a local MCP stdio server that can expose safe Ableton Live control commands through a local HTTP/UDP bridge and document how to connect it from an MCP client.
scope: Add a Node-based MCP server, bridge abstraction, smoke test, README usage instructions, and production-focused Ableton tools for VST selection, MIDI import, rendering, mastering, and project track modification.
testStrategy: Validate server module syntax and run a JSON-RPC smoke test over stdio without requiring Ableton to be installed.

title: Review codebase patterns and implementation consistency
goal: Review the project code, identify architectural and implementation patterns, and report whether the current code follows those patterns.
blockedReason: qa requested changes: MIDI clip note validation is incomplete: schema declares pitch/start/duration/velocity constraints, but validateToolInput only checks notes is an array; invalid note values are accepted and forwarded. list_plugins accepts kind/query but the real GET bridge call sends GET /plugins with no query/body, so filters are dropped outside dry-run. Bridge config reads ABLETON_BRIDGE_URL and ABLETON_BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS directly without startup validation or local-only enforcement, despite local-bridge/security rules. src/server.js is 350 lines and mixes tool registry, dispatch, protocol loop, validation, and schema helpers, exceeding the local 300-line module-boundary threshold. README MCP client config references a stale absolute path outside this repo.

title: Fix code pattern review findings
goal: Fix code review findings: deep MCP input validation, GET plugin filter forwarding, startup config validation/local bridge policy, module boundary cleanup, and README path correction.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid MIDI note values are rejected before reaching the bridge.
ableton_list_plugins forwards kind/query filters to the HTTP bridge in real mode.
Bridge configuration is centralized and validated at startup, including timeout and local-only URL policy.
server entrypoint is reduced below the local 300-line module-boundary threshold by extracting focused modules.
README client config references the current repo path and tests cover happy path plus new failure cases.

title: Implement minimal Ableton local bridge
goal: Create a minimal local HTTP bridge implementation with adapter boundaries for Ableton control and development-mode behavior for status, project, tempo, transport, and plugin inventory endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: A local bridge server can listen on 127.0.0.1:9789 or a configured loopback port.
The bridge implements /status, /project, /tempo, /transport/start, /transport/stop, and /plugins according to docs/ableton-bridge-contract.md.
The bridge has a clear adapter seam for real Ableton integration and a deterministic development adapter for local tests.
Tests verify the MCP server can call the bridge without ABLETON_MCP_DRY_RUN for status, tempo, transport, and plugins.

title: Validate MCP against real Ableton bridge
goal: Run the MCP server against the local bridge in non-dry-run mode and capture real integration evidence for status, project, tempo, and transport.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-dry-run smoke test exercises the MCP server through the HTTP bridge.
Evidence captures request/response shape and observable bridge state changes.
Any Ableton-unavailable constraint is documented with a deterministic local substitute and owner for live verification.

title: Implement snapshot and rollback bridge contract
goal: Implement snapshot persistence/rollback semantics for safe broad edits through the Ableton bridge contract.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /project/snapshot creates a named snapshot artifact or adapter checkpoint.
Rollback or restore behavior is documented and testable.
MCP snapshot calls are covered by tests and failure modes return contract-shaped errors.

title: Implement MIDI clip and import bridge features
goal: Implement /clips/midi and /midi/import bridge behavior with validated note/import payload handling and MCP integration tests.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /clips/midi accepts validated notes and updates bridge project state or real Ableton adapter.
POST /midi/import validates .mid/.midi import requests and exposes deterministic behavior in development mode.
Tests cover success and invalid payload cases through MCP-to-bridge flow.

title: Implement Ableton plugin inventory indexing
goal: Implement searchable plugin/device/preset inventory for /plugins with kind/query filtering and MCP integration coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /plugins supports kind and query filters.
Development adapter exposes deterministic fixtures for instruments/effects/racks/presets.
Real Ableton adapter integration path for device/preset discovery is documented with known limitations.

title: Implement real Ableton Python Remote Script adapter
goal: Add an installable Ableton Python Remote Script bridge that runs inside Ableton Live and implements the real local HTTP adapter endpoints for status, project, tempo, transport, plugin lookup, device loading, and mastering-chain application.
acceptanceCriteria: An Ableton MIDI Remote Script package exists with create_instance and a ControlSurface class that starts a loopback HTTP server.
The script implements the same endpoint contract used by the MCP bridge for status, project, tempo, transport, plugins, device loading, and mastering apply.
Live API calls are marshalled onto Ableton's control-surface thread instead of directly mutating Live from the HTTP thread.
Docs explain install location, Ableton preferences setup, startup verification, and the smoke command against Live.
Static validation covers Python syntax and repository tests still pass; live Ableton validation is explicitly deferred with owner and command.

title: Document Ableton Remote Script app-bundle permission workaround
goal: Improve installer and docs for macOS App Management/TCC failures when copying the Ableton Remote Script into the Ableton app bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: Installer failure output explains App Management/Full Disk Access and Finder/manual alternatives when mkdir or cp fails with Operation not permitted.
Docs mention that sudo may still fail on modern macOS and provide concrete remediation steps.

acceptanceCriteria: No repository source/docs/tests/package references contain external music project setup.
Remote Script package is generically named and tests/docs/install script use the new name.
Project tests pass after cleanup.

acceptanceCriteria: Remote Script handles DELETE /clips/midi and deletes the target clip when it exists.

goal: Fix Remote Script metering so /meters can report real Live audio signal when direct meter property reads stay at zero, using listener-backed cached values and explicit diagnostics.

title: Make meters effective against live Ableton runtime
goal: Determine the supported Live Remote Script metering path, implement reliable observable meters or an explicit unsupported contract, and validate the result against the user's running Ableton instance without modifying the set beyond playback.
blockedReason: qa requested changes: Implementation and deterministic regression tests pass. Live evidence proves zero-only meters during audible playback, and the new contract should classify that runtime as unreliable. Final acceptance requires reinstall/restart and live verification of reliableForMixing=false, meterCapability.status=zero-only-during-active-playback, bounded target counts, and the production report risk.
testStrategy: Run static and deterministic tests, reinstall the Remote Script, restart Ableton, then collect repeated localhost /meters samples during audible playback.
acceptanceCriteria: Meter cache uses stable logical target keys across Live proxy wrapper instances
During audible playback /meters reports pollCount greater than zero and non-zero signal on at least one track and master
Meter diagnostics do not inflate observed target counts beyond the seven current track, return, and master targets
When Live returns zero-only meters during active playback, /meters reports reliableForMixing=false with an explicit capability status
Production reports and playback diagnostics prevent meter-guided mixing when runtime meters are unreliable

title: Commit validated Ableton MCP 0.1.0 checkpoint
goal: Create a local commit containing the validated 0.1.0 product, installer, diagnostics, mixing contracts, and truthful meter capability; run release validation and do not push, tag, publish, or deploy.

title: Add verified rendered-audio metering
goal: Provide a trustworthy file-based metering workflow for rendered masters and stems when Ableton Remote Script live meters are unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze an existing master render and optional stem files without modifying the Ableton set.
Return measured loudness, peak, RMS or dynamics metrics with backend provenance and reliableForMixing=true only when analysis succeeds.
Keep rendered-audio measurements distinct from unsupported Live Remote Script meter values and never fabricate measurements.
Expose the workflow through the development HTTP adapter and MCP tools with deterministic automated tests and documentation.
assumptions: Users can export a master or stems from Ableton when Remote Script rendering is unsupported.
risks: Metric availability depends on installed ffmpeg filters; paths and subprocess invocation must remain safely validated.
scope: Build on the existing /analysis/audio and ffmpeg/ffprobe integration; accept local audio artifacts only. Do not automate Ableton GUI export in this task.
testStrategy: Unit and bridge integration tests with deterministic generated audio fixtures, full npm test, and a real local audio-file probe when available.

title: Expose raw Live meter property diagnostics
goal: Expose the exact Live object/property paths and raw direct/cache values used by meter polling so zero-only runtime behavior can be diagnosed without implying reliable signal.
acceptanceCriteria: Each track, return, and master meter response identifies its Live object path and the exact meter properties read.
Diagnostics expose raw direct and cached values, source, freshness, listener registration/error state, and has_audio_output without changing reliableForMixing semantics.
Automated tests cover populated, zero-only, unavailable, and listener-backed values.
The updated Remote Script is validated against the running Ableton instance after reinstall.
risks: Diagnostics can become noisy; keep the shape bounded to three properties per logical target.
scope: Read-only diagnostics only; do not add new meter properties or claim that zero-only Live values are valid for mixing.
testStrategy: Python cache tests, static contract tests, full npm test, reinstall Remote Script, then sample /meters during audible playback.

title: Fix transport command response consistency
goal: Make transport start/stop responses distinguish requested state from immediate Live readback so POST /transport/stop never reports playing=true as the command result when /status has stopped.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /transport/start returns playing=true and POST /transport/stop returns playing=false as the requested command result.
Responses expose requestedPlaying, observedPlaying, and confirmed so deferred Live state transitions remain truthful.
GET /status remains the authoritative observed transport state.
Automated tests and live validation cover start, stop, and immediate status readback without modifying composition or mix.
assumptions: Live may update song.is_playing after stop_playing returns within the same Control Surface callback.
risks: Clients may have assumed playing was an immediate observation; preserve that information explicitly as observedPlaying.
scope: Transport response contract only; do not alter clip launch, arrangement, composition, instruments, or mixer state.
testStrategy: Static Remote Script contract test, development bridge integration test, full npm test, reinstall/restart, then live start/stop/status comparison.

title: Discover and load Ableton Core audio effects
goal: Make Remote Script browser search and device loading reliably find built-in Core audio effects such as Utility and Channel EQ without GUI automation.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /browser/search?kind=audio_effect finds installed Core effects such as Utility or Channel EQ when Live exposes them.
POST /devices/load can load an exact browser result on a target track without fuzzy selection of an unrelated device.
Search diagnostics distinguish not found, traversal limit, unavailable edition, and non-loadable browser items.
Automated tests and live read-only search validation pass before any device is loaded into the user's set.
assumptions: Utility and Channel EQ are available in the installed Live edition but current recursive browser traversal fails to surface them.
risks: Live browser trees vary by version and edition; traversal must be bounded and report truncation.
scope: Browser discovery and exact-load contract only. Do not change guitar MIDI, instrument preset, fader, devices, or mix during implementation/QA.
testStrategy: Unit/static tests with nested browser fixtures, full npm test, reinstall/restart, then read-only searches for Utility and Channel EQ. Device loading requires separate explicit approval.
blockedReason: Paused behind safety-critical volume conversion and mixer rollback defects; no device load or mixing work may continue until both are fixed.

title: Fix Live volume dB write conversion
goal: Guarantee that volumeDb writes target the requested Ableton display dB without corrupting track levels through an incorrect raw-value conversion.
acceptanceCriteria: Volume writes use Live parameter conversion/display semantics or a verified calibrated mapping rather than assuming a linear raw scale.
Responses report requested dB, raw value written, observed raw value, observed display/dB, tolerance, and confirmation.
Unsafe or unverifiable dB writes fail closed and do not report success.
Automated round-trip tests cover the restored levels -7.372, -8.337, -10.161, and -5.68 dB plus boundary values.
No live mixer writes occur until the user explicitly approves post-reinstall validation.
